text_block_list.text:
After our outing, on the walk back
escorting Daiwa Scarlet to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I've gotten so used to hanging out with you
and staying out late having fun.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, it's quite tough maintaining my honor student image, you know?
choice_data_list: But you always look like you're having so much fun, huh?
But you always seem like you're having so much fun, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, don't get too carried away.
...Well, I won't deny that it's fun, though."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah——

Daiwa Scarlet suddenly pauses,
looking up at the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The evening star—
It's always so easy to spot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …………I love the first evening star.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No matter how vast the sky is, I can spot it right away,
and it shines brighter than anything elseâ

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Everyone says you're "number one," right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you think... I can become one?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To become the brightest star of the Twinkle Series—
choice_data_list: To me, you're already number one.
To me, you're already number one, you know.
I'll show you I can be the brightest star!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange.
When you say it, I actually believe in myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Because from the very beginning,
you've always believed in me."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because you tell me more powerfully than anyone else
that I can become number one...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I will become it.
The morning star you believe in... I swear it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So I'm counting on you from now on too, got it?
As the Trainer I believe in!

I want to live up to her expectations.
Deep in my heart, I reaffirmed that resolve once more.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, don't say weird things
with such a straight face!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, but... I don't mind.
Because you believe in me like that—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It makes me want to stay your number one.
It makes me want to become everyone's number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll be counting on you from now on too.
As my Trainer!

As her Trainer,
I renewed the vow in my heart to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
Well, aren't you speaking with total confidence.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, as my Trainer,
I'd expect nothing less from you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Just don't get the wrong idea, okay?
It's not going to happen solely through your efforts.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Only when your hard work combines with mine
can we finally become the brightest star, you know!

I renewed my strong resolve in my heart
to make her number one, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
――Yeah.
Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Show me. Make me the brightest star in the sky.
In return—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it too.
I'll turn you into the brightest star—the number one Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So let's...
aim for it together.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The very best Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahahaha!
Somehow, I just couldn't help laughing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What on earth
are we doing in a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You'd better not break the promise we made earlier, okay?
We're definitely going to reach number one together!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ――Let's go home.

Swearing to the evening star that we would surely fulfill
today's promise one day, the two of us returned to the academy.
